title: ResonanceSensorEvent
description: Authoritative schema for acoustic and vibration anomaly-monitoring telemetry events across Python, Node.js, and React.

schema_version.description: Semantic schema contract version. Restricted strictly to '1.0' for Phase 1.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for the event instance (e.g., evt_000001 or UUID). Note: Uniqueness across events is enforced at the ingest/stream runtime layer, as single-payload JSON Schema cannot enforce cross-payload uniqueness.

sensor_id.description: Unique identifier for the physical structure sensor point or simulated telemetry node (e.g., Pillar_A).

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp in RFC 3339 format strictly with 'Z' timezone designator (ISO 8601 subset, e.g., 2026-10-24T14:30:00.000Z). Non-UTC offsets are prohibited.

sequence.description: Strictly positive integer sequence number scoped per sensor stream. Note: Monotonic progression across events is enforced at the ingest/stream runtime layer, as single-payload JSON Schema validates individual payloads in isolation.

status.description: Classification result generated by anomaly detection model inference evaluated against configured decision thresholds.

anomaly_score.description: Unbounded non-negative anomaly severity score (0.0 = nominal baseline state; larger values represent greater deviation from baseline). NOTE: This is a non-negative continuous severity/distance metric, NOT a bounded probability or percentage.

features.description: Key acoustic/vibration signal features extracted over the sliding observation window.

rms.description: Root Mean Square (RMS) acceleration or displacement magnitude over the observation window. Non-negative finite float.

std_dev.description: Standard deviation of signal amplitudes over the observation window. Non-negative finite float.

dominant_frequency_hz.description: Peak spectral frequency identified via Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) analysis within the window, in Hertz (Hz). Non-negative finite float.

source.description: Data provenance tag indicating whether telemetry originates from synthetic/dataset replay simulation or physical microcontroller hardware.
